inferred_or_tuned.fig7_geometry_erratum: COMM-GEOMETRY-FIG7: literal2x1 Eq3 implies even azimuth fields, contradicting original EPS. Figure uses same two elements in1x2 orientation with source shape retained. No phase/spacing fitted to original curves.
inferred_or_tuned.stable_objective_difference: Same LSE minimized objective, evaluated by exact field increments and stable log1p/expm1 for small changes; independent75-digit Decimal full-dimension tests. No accepted-value slack.
inferred_or_tuned.accuracy_share_guard: After exhausting raw PR and recorded steepest-block retries, a block below tolerance/sqrt(number_of_blocks) may remain unchanged; the full actual global KKT measure must still meet the unchanged threshold. This prevents machine-precision inactive blocks obstructing active blocks, and is not an early convergence certificate.
inferred_or_tuned.line_search: Original distinct per-block alpha backtracking: each block uses actual projected/retracted displacement Armijo. The jointly combined block step is checked with total actual-displacement Armijo and is commonly scaled only if necessary; this coupling safeguard and constants are not specified in the paper. Common-alpha mode remains diagnostic only.
inferred_or_tuned.initialization: Portable Park-Miller phases, independent positive simplex entries then row normalization; seed not published.
inferred_or_tuned.scheduling_recovery: Largest relaxed entry, smallest index on exact tie; paper specifies thresholding but not its threshold.
inferred_or_tuned.non_descent: Raw per-block PR coefficients and slopes are preserved and recorded. A block restarts minus its current gradient if either its raw tangent slope or its initial-step feasible projected displacement slope is nonnegative; raw_non_descent and projected_non_descent reasons are recorded separately. Exact zero-gradient/empty blocks and zero projected boundary motions are inactive. The source specifies an open simplex but its Euclidean projection reaches the closed boundary; this documented numerical safeguard reports raw row-mean and projected/KKT norms separately, using the latter for guarded stopping. literal_printed retains raw-direction diagnostics. No feasibility tolerance is relaxed.
inferred_or_tuned.distance: Ambient product norm for outer step; intrinsic product distance not numerically specified.
inferred_or_tuned.spacing: Half-wavelength element spacing and normal incidence chosen because numerical paragraph does not specify these.
inferred_or_tuned.budgets: 6000 independent starts, 4000 RCG cap and 1e-6 gradient threshold are implementation settings, not quoted communication-paper values.
inferred_or_tuned.continuation: Five equally spaced initial mu in [100,1000], cycling across starts; final mu 1e-3. Paper prescribes equally spaced initial mu and halving but omits range/count/terminal value.
inferred_or_tuned.erratum: Minimize -f so original maximization of negative softmin is respected; published negative-gradient directions for +f contradict the maximization statement.
